text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that resumes prior warning while launching the divine judgment clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens by carrying the prior exposure of hidden acts into a new judicial claim. Because the particle does not govern case, the named subject that follows remains foregrounded, and the fused written form makes the transition and the divine subject arrive together.

topics.headline: resumptive launch into judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 40:20 as the next step from disclosed hidden knowledge into judgment, not as an isolated statement.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coordinates with prior discourse while the following clause is syntactically a fresh assertion.

topics.headline: prefixed transition fused to subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the transition is visibly attached to the divine-name launch rather than separated as a pause word.
topics.reason: The surface is a prefixed conjunction, so the boundary marker and subject onset are one written unit.

words.gloss_range: named divine subject of the first judgment verb; not an impersonal rule or generic deity label
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field tied to worship, devotion, and exclusive divine reference; local grammar selects the named judge role
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) stands as the explicit nominative subject of the first judgment verb, so judgment is not an abstract process. The proper name also keeps worship and appeal in view before the rival invoked class appears, and its later return closes the ayah by tying judgment to perception.

topics.headline: named subject fixes agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment assigned to the named divine subject before rival agency is tested.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the nominative subject of the active verb.

topics.headline: proper name carries worship exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the judge is not a generic power but the worshipped referent against whom invoked alternatives will be measured.
topics.reason: The worship-oriented name pressure survives, while the local syntactic role remains subject of judgment rather than a full derivational argument.

topics.headline: divine name frames judgment and perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same named referent from opening judgment to closing hearing and seeing.
topics.reason: The divine name appears near the opening and again in the final emphatic clause, forming a local frame.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect divine deciding, with no overt direct object and a following truth-standard complement
words.root_gloss_range: q-d-y range of deciding, decreeing, adjudicating, and bringing to completion; local form selects active divine judgment
words.prose: {{ar:يَقْضِى}} ({{tr:yaqḍī}}) presents divine q-d-y as active standing capacity. With no overt direct object, the following truth phrase supplies the basis rather than a thing judged, and the repeated root later becomes the ayah's test: what is affirmed for God is denied to rivals.

topics.headline: objectless verb points to standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader looks for the standard of judgment, not for a missing object to fill in.
topics.reason: The verb instance marks no direct object and a following bi-complement.

topics.headline: active imperfect decisive settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears judgment as ongoing decisive settlement by God, not a single past opinion or deagentivized outcome.
topics.reason: The active imperfect Form I verb with explicit subject supports direct divine adjudication and completion.

topics.headline: q-d-y axis affirmed then denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated root create the ayah's measuring axis between divine capacity and rival incapacity.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the first and second judgment clauses, with affirmation on God's side and negation on the rival side.

words.gloss_range: prefixed bāʾ linking judgment to truth as means, manner, or criterion
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) binds the judgment verb to the truth-standard. Its instrumental and criterial range lets truth function both as the means through which judgment operates and the measure according to which it is made, while the later matching preposition exposes the rival clause as a failed counterpart.

topics.headline: truth bound as means and measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truth grammatically attached to judgment rather than added as a loose value word.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark the particle as governing the truth noun as the verb's prepositional complement.

topics.headline: first preposition prepares failed counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first prepositional phrase set the pattern that the rival phrase will invert.
topics.reason: The first bi-phrase precedes the parallel rival bi-phrase, making the contrast formal.

words.gloss_range: definite truth/right standard governed by the first bāʾ; reality, due right, and established criterion
words.root_gloss_range: ḥ-q-q range of truth, right, due claim, obligation, and establishedness; local noun functions as judgment criterion
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) names an established standard, not an ad hoc force. Its root range lets judgment be both epistemic and moral: reality is recognized and due right is rendered. The word closes the first beat before the rival clause, so failure is measured against an already named standard.

topics.headline: definite established standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats truth as a known criterion governing judgment, not as a slogan after the fact.
topics.reason: The definite noun governed by the preposition functions locally as the standard or manner of q-d-y.

topics.headline: truth includes due claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment by truth also carries the rendering of what is owed, while the local form keeps this within the truth-standard phrase.
topics.reason: Derivative evidence supports entitlement and obligation pressure, but the surface word remains the definite noun standard.

topics.headline: truth standard heard before failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears rival incapacity fail against a determinate standard already in place.
topics.reason: The first clause ends with the truth-standard before the contrasted rival clause begins; same-surah and cross-passage truth/error rows support that polemical role.

words.gloss_range: second conjunction pivoting from divine judgment to the opposed relative subject
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots into the rival clause. It links the two halves closely enough for comparison, but because it introduces a full relative subject, the linkage becomes adversative: divine q-d-y is set beside rival non-q-d-y as matched argumentative beats.

topics.headline: coordinating pivot into opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rival clause as a direct comparison with the divine judgment clause, not as a detached addition.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the contrasted nominal clause, and the repeated judgment root makes coordination function adversatively.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun serving as the rival subject defined by invocation and tested by negated judgment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted second-person reading of the invocation verb, used as contrast for direct address while the local subject remains the relative group

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the rivals a relative subject: they are identified through the invocation relation before their incapacity is stated. The form personifies them for the sake of the argument, then the predicate removes the agency that such personification might imply; the accepted second-person reading of {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}) also keeps the callers under scrutiny.

topics.headline: relative subject tested by power predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the invoked class defined by relation and then tested for actual agency.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject of the negated judgment predicate and is defined by the following relative clause.

topics.headline: caller and called relation remains live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the invocation relation can confront both the invoked objects and the people addressing them, while the canonical local subject remains the relative group.
topics.reason: The variant reading supports rhetorical confrontation, but the local parse still treats the relative pronoun as the rival subject.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural invocation inside the relative clause, portraying ongoing collective appeal to alternatives
words.root_gloss_range: d-ʿ-w range of calling, supplication, summoning, claiming, and appeal; local use targets misdirected invocation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted second-person reading of the invocation verb, sharpening the same false-appeal charge into direct address

words.prose: {{ar:يَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:yadʿūna}}) defines the rivals through the social act of appeal before the ayah denies their capacity to judge. The imperfect plural makes that appeal a continuing collective practice, and the accepted {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}) reading sharpens the same charge into direct address. The d-ʿ-w field keeps prayer, petition, and claim together as the practice under review.

topics.headline: ongoing collective invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees false appeal as a recurring social practice exposed before it is refuted.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural occurs inside the relative clause and precedes the negated capacity predicate.

topics.headline: variant makes accusation direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an accepted reading can turn the report into direct confrontation without changing the incapacity claim.
topics.reason: The second-person reading shifts person and rhetoric, while the semantic frame of invoked powers failing remains stable.

topics.headline: calling field becomes authority test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the issue as trust in an appealed-to respondent, not speech alone.
topics.reason: The d-ʿ-w rows connect calling, prayer, claim, and futile beside-God invocation; locally this leads into denied judgment.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the besides phrase, marking separation, exclusion, and removal from the divine reference point
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) starts the separation frame before the negation appears. By governing and audibly binding into the following lower-rank term, it makes a compact exclusion phrase: the invoked alternatives are set apart from the divine reference point first, and only then does the ayah deny them judgment.

topics.headline: separation frame before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first locates the rivals outside the proper reference point, then hears their authority emptied.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following noun in the invocation phrase before the negated predicate begins.

topics.headline: particle binds compactly to phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the separation marker as part of one compact exclusion phrase rather than a loose connector.
topics.reason: The phonetic row describes the particle as audibly bound to the following phrase, matching the local syntactic dependency.

words.gloss_range: genitive governed complement meaning below/besides Him, with suffix anchoring alternatives to God as reference point
words.root_gloss_range: d-w-n range of below, short of, besides, lower rank, and relational exclusion; local phrase marks inferior alternatives

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: separating preposition that governs the lower-rank complement and frames the invoked alternatives as apart from God

words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهِ}} ({{tr:dūnihi}}) is not a free aside; it is the governed complement of {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}). Its suffix anchors the comparison to God, and the d-w-n range gives the alternatives a lower, short-of-Him rank before their incapacity is named. The familiar beside-God invocation pattern is sharpened from failure to answer into failure to judge.

topics.headline: suffix anchors the comparison to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader measures every rival by relation to God rather than by independent status.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition and carries a suffix resolved to the divine referent.

topics.headline: below and besides rank alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears false invocation as downward or lower-rank substitution, not merely alternate address.
topics.reason: The d-w-n field supports lower-rank and beside/exclusion pressure, while local grammar keeps it inside the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: beside-God call becomes judgment failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar false-invocation pattern intensified into a denial of adjudicative authority.
topics.reason: The rows connect beside-God calling with response failure and local pre-negation placement before denied q-d-y.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over the imperfect plural judgment verb and its indefinite complement
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) removes not one verdict but an ongoing claimed capacity. With the indefinite complement later in the clause, the negation becomes comprehensive: the rivals are first identified through invocation, then their judgment-predicate is audibly cut off.

topics.headline: negation of ongoing capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a standing incapacity over any case, not a report of one failed decision.
topics.reason: The negator scopes over an imperfect plural verb, and the indefinite complement inside the same clause widens the denial.

topics.headline: denial lands after rivals are identified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence: invocation defines misplaced trust, then negation removes its authority claim.
topics.reason: The negation follows the relative identification and precedes the repeated judgment root.

words.gloss_range: negated active plural imperfect of the same judgment root, grammatically assigning agency only to empty it
words.root_gloss_range: q-d-y range of deciding, decreeing, settling, and completing; local use denies that capacity to rivals

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over the rival judgment verb and its indefinite complement

words.prose: {{ar:يَقْضُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqḍūna}}) repeats the judgment root in plural active form under negation. The form lets the rivals stand grammatically as agents only for {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) to empty that agency; the same q-d-y affirmed for God with a truth-standard is denied to them across the any-thing domain.

topics.headline: same judgment root denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah testing rivals by the exact capacity just affirmed for God.
topics.reason: The verb is active plural imperfect, agrees with the relative subject, and is negated by the preceding particle.

topics.headline: truth versus anything contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine judgment tied to truth while rival nonjudgment is tied to an empty any-thing domain.
topics.reason: The two q-d-y verbs carry contrasting complements: truth on the divine side and an indefinite negated domain on the rival side.

words.gloss_range: second prefixed bāʾ governing the indefinite complement within the scope of negated judgment
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the indefinite complement to negated q-d-y, expanding what rivals cannot decide with respect to or by means of. Because the same preposition already bound divine judgment to truth, this repetition gives the contrast a formal hinge: same bāʾ, opposite judicial result.

topics.headline: bāʾ defines denied domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denial range widened through the prepositional complement, not limited to the verb alone.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the indefinite noun after the negated verb and remains inside the negation scope.

topics.headline: parallel prepositions expose asymmetry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formal symmetry between the two bāʾ phrases while the meanings diverge sharply.
topics.reason: The first bi-phrase marks divine judgment by truth; the second marks rival nonjudgment with anything.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive thing/matter under negation, universalizing rival incapacity to any object-domain
words.root_gloss_range: sh-y-ʾ range of thing, matter, referable entity, and what can be specified or willed; local use selects the minimal any-thing domain
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) is indefinite under negation, so it does not mean one unspecified matter; it opens the denial to any matter at all. Its bare thingness pushes rival incapacity to the smallest referable unit, while the contrast with definite truth makes God's side determinate and the rival side empty.

topics.headline: indefinite under negation universalizes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands that no object, affair, claim, or event remains available for rival judgment.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite, genitive after the preposition, and inside the scope of the negated predicate.

topics.headline: thingness as determinable domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees rival authority denied even over what can be specified as a thing, while local syntax keeps the sense as the negated any-thing complement.
topics.reason: Will/specification rows enrich the thing-domain, and 36:82 provides contrast with divine command, but the local role is an indefinite negated complement.

topics.headline: clause closes on empty rival domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rival clause end by widening incapacity after the verb and setting bare thingness against determinate truth.
topics.reason: The complement arrives last and contrasts with the first clause's definite truth-standard.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the final nominal clause that grounds the preceding contrast
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the closing clause into confirmation and explanation. After rival judgment has been denied, the particle grounds exclusive q-d-y in divine perception: the hearing and seeing titles are proof, not ornament.

topics.headline: confirmed ground after denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the final attributes as the reason judgment belongs to God, not as a detached devotional ending.
topics.reason: The particle introduces an emphatic final nominal clause after the rival-denial clause, and attachment evidence marks the following divine name as its governed noun.

words.gloss_range: repeated divine name as the accusative noun of the emphatic particle before the separator and perception predicates
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field tied to worship and exclusive divine reference; local case makes it the emphatic subject of the closing proof

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic particle governing the repeated divine name in the closing explanatory clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) repeats the name where a pronoun could have sufficed. Under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it re-centers the named divine referent before the separator and titles, so the perception predicates belong exclusively to the one who judged by truth at the opening.

topics.headline: governed name before predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final titles asserted about God as the governed emphatic subject, not as loose descriptions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the governed noun of the emphatic particle before the separator and predicates.

topics.headline: repeated name recenters exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure refuses to let rivals share the referent of hearing and seeing.
topics.reason: The repeated proper name, rather than a pronoun alone, re-identifies the divine referent before the perception pair.

topics.headline: same name moves from act to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the name from nominative judge to accusative explanatory subject, with a delay that sharpens exclusivity before the titles land.
topics.reason: The first occurrence functions as subject of the act, while this occurrence bears the emphatic particle's case in the closing explanation.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun of separation or emphasis between the divine name and the definite predicates
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) is not needed for bare predication, so its presence focuses the closure. As a separator, it blocks the titles from feeling like loose adjectives and makes them land as exclusive identity claims about God.

topics.headline: separator focuses predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the hearing and seeing titles as asserted predicates, not as incidental adjectives.
topics.reason: Local evidence marks the pronoun as reinforcing or separating before the predicates rather than serving as an ordinary new subject.

topics.headline: pronoun delays the title pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a small pause before the perception pair, sharpening the exclusive explanation.
topics.reason: The pronoun stands between the repeated name and the predicates, delaying their arrival.

words.gloss_range: first definite perception predicate, presenting hearing as stable comprehensive reception after invocation has been named
words.root_gloss_range: s-m-ʿ range of hearing, listening, receiving, and attentive auditory perception; local title grounds judgment in full reception of calls and claims
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمِيعُ}} ({{tr:al-samīʿu}}) is a definite predicate-title after the separator, so hearing appears as a stable divine attribute rather than an event. It directly answers the earlier invocation verb: calls matter only before the one whose hearing actually receives them. Paired with seeing, it supplies one channel of the perceptive basis for true judgment.

topics.headline: definite stable hearing predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing as a fixed predicate that underwrites judgment, not occasional listening.
topics.reason: The word is a definite nominative predicate-title after the separator, with faʿīl stability and intensity rows supporting the local title force.

topics.headline: hearing answers calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the call-field to the closing title: invocation is judged by whether the addressee truly hears.
topics.reason: The earlier invocation verb makes auditory reception locally relevant, and derivative rows deepen hearing as full attention.

topics.headline: paired perception grounds judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing and seeing together as the knowledge rivals lack for any valid decision.
topics.reason: The local pair and cross-passage/surah recurrence rows connect the perception titles to uniqueness and judgment.

words.gloss_range: second definite perception predicate completing the hearing-seeing pair without a conjunction
words.root_gloss_range: b-ṣ-r range of seeing, perceiving, discerning, insight, and visible evidence; local title closes judgment with comprehensive discernment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَصِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-baṣīru}}) completes the perception pair as a second definite predicate. Its b-ṣ-r range gives the closure more than eyesight: it is discerning perception that answers hidden acts and states. The ayah's frame is therefore complete: the God who judges by truth is the one whose hearing and seeing warrant that judgment.

topics.headline: second definite predicate completes pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears seeing locked to hearing as a coordinated title-pair, not a separate loose epithet.
topics.reason: The word follows the first title as a definite nominative second predicate coordinated by juxtaposition.

topics.headline: seeing includes discernment of hidden realities
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the judgment grounded in perception of realities hidden from rivals, including what 40:19 exposed.
topics.reason: Sight, insight, and hidden-eye boundary rows support discerning perception as the local payoff.

topics.headline: opening judgment closes with perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah ring from divine judgment to the perception that justifies it.
topics.reason: Cross-passage, same-surah, and ayah-ring rows link the final seeing title with hearing and the opening q-d-y claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated q-d-y predicates at words 2 and 9 are split between affirmation with haqq and total negation with shay.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first predicate is a decisive, reality-matched judgment; the mirrored predicate is denied across the entire object domain. Invocation of an alternative therefore yields neither jurisdiction nor a binding result.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication supplies the mirrored act that is affirmed for God and denied of the invoked figures.
Stable correspondence with reality qualifies the positive judgment and excludes arbitrary force.
A voiced call directed toward an addressee makes the rival relation a request for responsive authority.
Otherness marks the invoked figures as alternatives outside the sole source of judgment.
The maximally general knowable object gives the negative clause unrestricted scope.

changed_reading.before: God judges truthfully, whereas other gods judge nothing.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an asymmetrical tribunal: one authority issues binding decisions that match reality, while every invoked alternative has an empty adjudicative domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The q-d-y pair can denote completion and effective execution as well as courtroom judgment, while shay can denote an object of will.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this branch, qada is the carrying of an intended affair through to a finished, effective state. The rivals' inability is therefore practical and ontological, not merely an inability to pronounce a verdict.

activation_trace.role: Completion and exhaustion open a process reading in which an affair reaches its endpoint.
Precisely made and effective action shifts the contrast from verbal ruling toward enactment.
The relation between will and a thing makes the negated object a possible intended actuality.

changed_reading.after: God alone carries an affair through to completed actuality; the invoked alternatives cannot consummate even one intended thing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair al-sami and al-basir immediately follows the contrast in qada.
baseline_models.mechanism: Auditory reception, understanding, visual observation, and inward discernment form a two-channel warrant for judgment. The names explain why the positive qada is with truth rather than merely appending praise.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment is the operation for which the final perceptual pair supplies warrant.
Reception of voiced evidence supplies the auditory side of the adjudicative record.
Understanding and acceptance extend hearing from raw sound to grasped testimony.
Direct sight supplies observation of visible acts and conditions.
Inward discernment supplies knowledge that penetrates beyond visible appearance.

changed_reading.before: The hearing and seeing names are a general doxological close.
changed_reading.after: The names function as the evidentiary warrant of the verdict: every utterance is received and every visible or inward fact is discerned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early false disputation tries to make truth lose its footing; the exact later reprise of qada with haqq ends with the falsifiers losing. The focus judgment is thus a reversal operation that restores truth's standing and removes falsehood's.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication is the central operation that reverses the contested relation.
Truth made manifest gives qada an active stabilizing role rather than a merely descriptive quality.
Twisted disputation supplies the adversarial pressure placed upon truth.
Loss of truth and stability characterizes the medium used by the disputants.
A foot slipping from its hold supplies the attempted displacement of truth.
The later exact adjudicative predicate makes the focus construction an event with a disclosed outcome.
Manifested truth marks what the later judgment establishes.
General loss supplies the reversed outcome now borne by the false side.
Those defined by instability and departure from truth become the losers rather than the dislodgers.

structural_cues: At 40:5 false disputation is explicitly directed at dislodging truth; at 40:78 the focus construction returns and falsifiers lose.
The two scenes reverse agent and patient: falsehood first acts upon truth, then truth-bearing judgment acts upon falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the attempted displacement and the later loss; I infer that the focus clause is the hinge reversing that direction. A live alternative is that the two episodes simply repeat condemnation without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: Judging with truth means issuing a correct verdict.
changed_reading.after: Judging with truth is the act that reverses falsehood's attempted displacement: it re-establishes truth and transfers loss to the falsifying claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places solitary invocation and partnership immediately before the declaration that judgment belongs to God, then makes failed leaders concede that God has already judged between the servants. Rival inability is therefore lack of delegated jurisdiction, not merely weak performance.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication supplies the jurisdiction whose exclusive ownership is tested.
Calling identifies the attempted route to an alternative authority.
Otherness locates that attempted authority outside the rightful jurisdiction.
The call directed to God alone supplies the rejected exclusive relation.
Partnership supplies the attempted sharing of authority that the hearers accept.
Judgment between people is explicitly assigned to God after the invocation contrast.
The failed leaders' concession confirms that judgment between servants has already been exercised elsewhere.

structural_cues: At 40:12 the call-versus-partnership contrast resolves directly into exclusive divine judgment.
At 40:47-48 dependents appeal to their former leaders, but the leaders can only point to God's completed judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-located invocation, association, and exclusive judgment; I infer a jurisdictional boundary that no invoked partner can cross. The alternative is a simpler contrast of power or competence without legal delegation.

changed_reading.before: The rivals are too powerless to judge.
changed_reading.after: The rivals are categorically unauthorized co-adjudicators: invocation cannot delegate even the smallest part of God's jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, covert eye-action and concealed interiors are known; later the same hearing-seeing pair follows unsupported dispute and pride hidden in breasts. The closing names therefore describe an audit that joins public speech, visible conduct, and concealed motive before judgment.

activation_trace.role: Auditory reception brings every voiced plea and argument into the record.
Understanding turns heard speech into assessed testimony rather than undifferentiated sound.
Inward discernment lets the audit reach motive and meaning beyond appearance.
Disclosure to the knower supplies complete access to otherwise hidden evidence.
A covert breach of fidelity supplies an act designed to evade ordinary witnesses.
Concealment supplies the evidentiary boundary that divine perception crosses.
The inward source from which acts issue locates motive within the audit.
Twisted dispute supplies the audible public presentation being assessed.
A compelling warrant is explicitly absent, making source validation central.
Magnification within the chest supplies the concealed motive beneath the argument.
The repeated hearing title marks comprehension of the disputants' speech.
The repeated seeing title marks discernment of the pride hidden behind that speech.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding ayah moves from a covert eye-act to what breasts conceal.
At 40:56 unsupported disputation, inward pride, and the exact hearing-seeing pair occur in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden evidence, public argument, absent warrant, and concealed motive; I infer that the final names are the audit basis of qada. They could alternatively remain a general assurance of omniscience without a specifically forensic function.

changed_reading.before: God hears and sees everything in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: The judge receives every utterance, validates its warrant, observes conduct, and penetrates concealed motive; truth-bearing judgment follows a complete evidentiary audit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later call sequence distinguishes calls with no standing, calls that go missing, and a call answered by God. The focus can therefore contrast a complete response circuit with invocations that terminate without an effective answer or settled result.

activation_trace.role: A voiced call initiates the response circuit tested by the rest of the surah.
Hearing supplies reception at the divine end of a successful call.
Effective execution supplies the terminal act that converts reception into consequential response.
The paired call forms deny the rival destination any viable call in either temporal domain.
Repeated calling supplies an attempted appeal whose endpoint is explicitly ineffective.
A lost object supplies the image of a call that never reaches an efficacious destination.
The imperative to call supplies the valid opening of the divine response circuit.
Returned speech and answer supply the explicit successful endpoint absent from rival invocation.

structural_cues: The sequence 40:41-43 contrasts reciprocal calls toward rescue and fire, then denies the rival call standing.
The failed appeal of 40:49-50 is answered by the direct call-and-answer promise of 40:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, reception, failed arrival, and answer; I supply the arrow from divine hearing through qada to effective response. The live alternative is that qada remains purely judicial and the prayer sequence is only a thematic contrast.

changed_reading.before: People pray to rivals, but those rivals cannot judge.
changed_reading.after: Rival invocation is an open circuit: no received call becomes an effective settled outcome, while divine hearing proceeds to answer and consequential action.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 40:68 qada of an affair is ordered directly before speech and realized being. That sequence activates the effective-making branch of qada and makes the focus contrast include the ability to carry an affair from settled intent into actuality.

activation_trace.role: Effective, well-formed execution supplies the focus sense sharpened by the later command sequence.
A thing as the object of will supplies the possible actuality rivals cannot realize.
The same effective-making branch explicitly governs an affair in the later sequence.
An affair or state supplies the content settled by qada.
Articulated speech supplies the transition from settled affair toward realization.
Occurrence and temporal presence supply the realized endpoint of the sequence.

structural_cues: At 40:68 giving life and death is followed by qada of an affair, divine speech, and immediate being.
The sequence preserves ordered stages rather than using qada as an isolated legal term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four ordered elements: settled affair, utterance, occurrence, and presence; I supply the causal arrow from qada through speech to actuality. A live alternative is that qada only decides the affair and a distinct command performs it.

changed_reading.before: God issues the uniquely true ruling.
changed_reading.after: God's qada can be performative completion: an affair is settled, voiced, and made actual, whereas rivals cannot carry even one thing across that sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah individualizes recompense by acquisition, blocks an effective intercessor, and depicts dependents asking leaders to absorb an assigned share before those leaders invoke God's completed judgment. The debt-discharge branch of qada makes rival inability include failure to settle or transfer even a fragment of liability.

activation_trace.role: Payment and full discharge of a due right supply the liability-settlement sense under contextual activation.
The unrestricted object makes the denial reach even the smallest transferable item or share.
Action met by its counterpart supplies individualized recompense.
What a self acquires supplies the personal account to which recompense attaches.
An intercessor joining another's case supplies the blocked route for burden transfer.
A prevailing legal argument supplies the explicit dispute over responsibility in the fire.
Sufficiency supplies the requested ability of leaders to relieve their dependents.
An assigned elevated share supplies the portion the dependents ask the leaders to absorb.
Completed judgment between servants fixes the allocation the leaders cannot renegotiate.

structural_cues: At 40:17 each self receives the counterpart of what it acquired, with no injustice.
At 40:18 no obeyed intercessor is available; at 40:47-48 leaders cannot absorb even a share for their dependents because judgment is fixed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies individualized earning, blocked joinder, an attempted share transfer, and fixed judgment; I infer that qada's discharge sense connects adjudication to settlement of liability. The alternative is that qada denotes verdict only and the debt image should remain latent.

changed_reading.before: The invoked figures cannot issue decisions.
changed_reading.after: No invoked patron can discharge a caller's account, absorb an assigned share, or transfer even one item of liability after the truthful judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material branch of haqq pictures a fitting joint or receptacle, while contextual zulm pictures putting something outside its proper place and recompense is like-for-like. Qada with haqq can therefore be modeled as fitting each case into its proper legal and moral place.

activation_trace.role: A part fitting its joint or receptacle supplies the material image of exact placement.
Exact and effective construction supplies the act of placing a case into that fit.
Any knowable object becomes a possible item requiring correct placement.
Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the negated failure mode.
Equivalence supplies the matching relation between deed and consequence.
Restraint and corrective return supply the function that restores a disordered relation.

structural_cues: The no-injustice statement at 40:17 is immediately adjacent to the focus and defines the prohibited misplacement.
At 40:40 an evil act receives its like, giving the placement model a proportional matching rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material fit, contextual misplacement, and equivalence; I infer a justice-as-correct-placement mechanism. A live alternative is ordinary proportional fairness with no intended material image.

changed_reading.before: God judges according to abstract truth.
changed_reading.after: God fits every deed, claim, and consequence into its proper joint; the alternatives cannot correctly place or settle even one thing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah every thing is encompassed, nothing is hidden, kingship is singularly claimed, and every thing is created by God. The negated shay in the focus then describes an empty rival domain: no object remains outside divine knowledge, ownership, and making for another authority to adjudicate.

activation_trace.role: Otherness proposes a rival domain whose contents the context tests.
The unrestricted knowable object defines the candidate domain over which judgment could operate.
Adjudication supplies the authority whose object domain is partitioned.
Unopposed expansiveness supplies total encompassing scope.
Every knowable object fills that encompassing scope.
Concealment is denied any capacity to remove an object from divine access.
The unrestricted object again closes the possibility of a hidden remainder.
Sovereign rule supplies ownership of the whole exposed domain.
Origination supplies the deepest basis for authority over the domain.
Every knowable object is included in the created set, leaving no residual object for rivals.

structural_cues: The universal shay recurs with encompassing mercy and knowledge, non-concealment, and creation.
The kingship question at 40:16 is answered within the same universal-object frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total scope, non-concealment, sovereignty, and creation; I infer that these exhaust the possible object set and leave rival jurisdiction empty. The alternative is rhetorical universality without a formal domain contrast.

changed_reading.before: The rivals happen not to judge anything.
changed_reading.after: They have nothing available to judge: every possible object is already encompassed, exposed, owned, and created within divine jurisdiction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because call or worship remains the primary sense of d-a-w, but the focus inventory also supplies claiming a right or affiliation and the surah surrounds the focus with contested truth and absent warrant. Downstream prose should present it only as a forensic secondary echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins d-a-w, q-d-y, and haqq in one contrast, allowing invocation to echo the advancement of a claim before a judge.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation lets invocation also sound like putting forward a litigated authority.
A right owned by its claimant supplies the subject matter such a pleading would seek to vindicate.
Opposing parties each asserting truth supplies the contested forensic setting.
Decisive adjudication supplies the tribunal before which the claimed authority fails.
Twisted contest supplies the surrounding pattern of litigated assertions.
The absent compelling proof exposes the rival pleading as unauthorized.

changed_reading.before: Those people worship or call other beings.
changed_reading.after: They also put those beings forward as claimed authorities, but the pleading cannot establish a right or produce a decision about anything.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because min dunihi idiomatically marks alternatives besides God, yet its branch also means nearer than and short of a goal, while qada can mean completion and the Pharaoh scene dramatizes failed ascent through connections. Render it only as a secondary spatial pressure on the idiom, not as its sole lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Dun at word 7 can picture being below or short of the endpoint, while q-d-y at words 2 and 9 can picture reaching completion.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that falls short of the goal locates rival authorities below the terminal source.
Completion supplies the endpoint that lower intermediaries cannot reach.
Reaching a limit supplies Pharaoh's attempted movement toward the inaccessible endpoint.
A cord or connection supplies the imagined chain of intermediary access.
Ascending to overlook and uncover supplies the failed attempt to inspect the divine endpoint from below.

changed_reading.before: The phrase refers to beings other than God.
changed_reading.after: It also faintly pictures a chain of authorities that remains below and short of completion: no intermediary can carry an affair all the way to its terminal result.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material image is surprising and branch-distant, but it remains anchored in the focus haqq inventory and is activated by the surah's contrast between making truth slip and an outcome that hits its target. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image of decisiveness, not a lexical paraphrase of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Haqq at word 3 includes a straight thrust that penetrates, while q-d-y includes effective execution.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust that penetrates without veering supplies the verdict's material trajectory.
Effective execution turns the straight trajectory into a consequential act.
Slippage supplies the opposing attempt to make truth veer or lose purchase.
Aimed contact with a target supplies the contextual image of an announced consequence landing.

changed_reading.after: The verdict also carries a contained image of straight, non-glancing force: it reaches and penetrates the point that false disputation tried to make slip.

strongest_changes: The 40:5 to 40:78 arc turns qada with haqq into a reversal that restores truth's footing and makes falsifiers lose.
The ordered qada-speech-being sequence at 40:68 strongly activates performative completion alongside legal judgment.
The immediate hidden-evidence frame and the repeated hearing-seeing pair at 40:56 make the closing names an adjudicative audit.
The failed patronage scene activates qada as nontransferable liability and unsuccessful discharge, not only verdict.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did not collapse qada into one sense: adjudication, effective completion, discharge of liability, and correct placement remained coexisting readings, all constrained by the focus call-truth-hearing-seeing structure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 40:68 causally folds creation into qada or merely places decision before a distinct performative command.
Whether the claim sense of d-a-w and the below-the-goal sense of dun are intended secondary echoes or only licensed exploratory branches.
Whether the material fit and penetrating images of haqq should reach prose synthesis or remain trace-only diagnostics.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Judgment requires both decisiveness and contact with reality.** Repeated `ق ض ي/B001` gives a binding settlement; `ح ق ق/B001` gives truth matching what is established. The divine/other-agent contrast assigns effective closure only to the first. I infer that hearing and seeing supply complete evidentiary access; the ayah reads rival inability as failure to make any reality-binding determination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The explicit “judged between the servants” in 40:48 and decisive settlement in 40:78 reveal the social and terminal reach of the reality-binding judgment stated here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Judicial capacity rests on complete reception of evidence.** Lexically, `ق ض ي:B001` is "decisive ruling or command," `س م ع:B003` includes understanding and compliance, and `ب ص ر:B002` is inner sight. Structurally, 40:17 establishes accounting, 40:18 removes effective advocates, and 40:19 exposes covert glance and hidden chest before this contrast between two kinds of adjudicator. Hearing and seeing supply the evidentiary reach that the invoked others lack. The packet places exhaustive disclosure before decisive judgment; I infer that the former grounds the latter. The contrast is therefore functional: the others decide nothing because they neither receive the whole case nor control its settlement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:48 repeats completed adjudication, while 40:51 supplies standing witnesses and 40:78 repeats ruling by truth; together they confirm the evidence-to-decision mechanism.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı karara bağlama anlamıyla kesin bir buyruk verme anlamını aynı dalda açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kesinlik, yalnızca kararın söylenmesini değil, konunun ayrılıp sonuçlandırılmasını da anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bildirimde bulunmayı, bir işi bitirmeyi, borç ödemeyi veya ölümü değil; bağlayıcı bir yargı ya da kesin buyruk vermeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, hükme bağlama ve kesin buyruk verme çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; başka dallara özgü kalıp anlamları bu tanıma katılmaz.

error_profile.loses: Yargı dışındaki kesin buyruk verme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu dalı yanlışın karşıtı olan doğruluk, gerçekliğe uygunluk, kesin olarak bilme ve sözün gerçek anlamında kullanılması çevresinde kurar. Verilen dal kimliği bu ortak çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyin gerçekliğe uygun ve doğru oluşunu anlatır; çekişme, yükümlülük ve kişiye ait pay bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kullanımlar doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çekirdeğini taşır; yemin bildiren kalıp yalnız kendi söz dizimi içinde değerlendirilir ve dalın genel anlamına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşüncenin, sözün ya da durumun gerçekten var olana uygun düşmesi ve bu nedenle yanlışın karşısında doğru, sağlam ve kesin sayılmasıdır. Söz bakımından ayrıca eğretilemenin karşısındaki gerçek anlamı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gerçekte var olana uygun düşen şey doğru ve sağlamdır.
Bir konuyu araştırıp doğruluğundan kesin biçimde emin olma bu çekirdeğin bilgi alanındaki uzantısıdır.
Bir sözün eğretileme olmadan ilk konulduğu anlamda kullanılması, dil alanındaki özel görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, yanlışın karşısındaki doğruluğu gerçekliğe uygunlukla açıklar; kesin olarak öğrenmeyi ve sözün eğretilemesiz gerçek anlamını da aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşüncenin, sözün veya durumun gerçekten var olana uygun ve yanlışın karşıtı olduğunu bütün çekirdeğiyle anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçekliğe uygunluk, doğruluk ve kesinlik öğelerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün ya da yargının yanlış olmadığını belirten günlük bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yanlışın karşısında bulunma ve gerçekliğe uygunluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kesin bilgi ile gerçek anlam kullanımını tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün eğretileme değil, ilk ve doğrudan anlamında kullanıldığını belirtirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dilsel kullanımın eğretilemesiz ve yerli yerinde oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel doğruluk ve kesin bilgi yönlerini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin gerekli ve bağlayıcı hale gelmesini, bir kişinin ona layık ya da onunla yükümlü olmasını, ayrıca gerekli kılma ve hak etme işlemlerini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu ilişkileri doğru toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir işin bağlayıcı biçimde gerekli olması veya bir sonucun kişiye düşmesidir; yalnızca doğru olma ya da özel mülkiyet payı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ve türemiş biçimler gereklilik ile hak edişi taşır; belirli ilgeç ve söz öbeklerine bağlı yönler kendi kalıplarında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yapılması zorunlu olacak biçimde bağlayıcı hale gelmesi veya bir kişinin bir yükümlülüğe, sonuca ya da karşılığa layık duruma gelmesidir. Buna gerekli kılma ve sonucu kendi davranışıyla üzerine çekme de dahildir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerekli hale gelmesi, artık kaçınılamayan bir bağlayıcılık doğurur.
Bir kişinin bir işi yapmaya layık veya onunla yükümlü olması aynı ilişkinin kişi yönüdür.
Bir şeyi gerekli kılmak ya da bir sonucu davranışla hak etmek, durumun ettirgen ve dönüşlü uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, gereklilik ve bağlayıcılığı kişi açısından layık olma, yükümlü tutulma, gerekli kılma ve bir sonucu hak etme yönleriyle bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin zorunlu hale gelmesini ve buna bağlı yükümlülük ya da hak ediş ilişkisini birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye ait olan özel istemi veya payı, bunun başkasına karşı ileri sürülmesini ve kişiye öncelik vermesini açıkça anlatır. Dal kimliği bu sahiplik ilişkisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada genel zorunluluk değil, belirli bir sahibin isteyebileceği özel pay, yetki veya öncelik söz konusudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler kişiye ait payı bildirir; bir malın başkasının elinden hükümle alınmasını anlatan kullanım kendi işlem bağlamında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir kişiye ait olan, sahibinin başkasından isteyebildiği veya başkasına karşı ileri sürebildiği özel pay, yetki ya da önceliktir. Bu bağın tanınıp malın sahibine geçirilmesi de aynı alanın işlem yönüdür.

facets.statement: Özel pay veya yetki belirli bir sahibine bağlıdır ve onun tarafından istenebilir.
Birden çok isteyen arasında bir kişinin daha öncelikli sayılması sahiplik ilişkisinin özel görünümüdür.
Sahiplik bağının tanınmasıyla bir malın onu elinde tutandan alınıp sahibine verilmesi işlem yönünü oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, genel bir doğruluktan daha özel olarak kişiye ait payı, bu paydaki önceliği ve sahibinin başkasına karşı sahiplik bağını kurmasını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinde tarafların çekişmesi, her birinin doğrunun veya payın kendisinde olduğunu ileri sürmesi ve kimi kullanımda bir tarafın üstün gelmesi açıkça yer alır. Dal kimliği bu karşılıklı yapıyı doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, iki ya da daha çok tarafın aynı doğruluk veya pay iddiasıyla karşı karşıya gelmesidir; çekişmesiz doğruluk bu dala girmez.

facets.statement: Taraflar karşılıklı olarak çekişir ve her biri kendi savının doğru olduğunu ileri sürer.
Çekişmenin sonunda bir tarafın savını kabul ettirerek ötekine üstün gelmesi olası sonuçtur.
Önemsiz ve küçük konularda durmadan çekişme, kalıba bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حاقه وحاققته وتحاق القوم واحتقوا، أي تخاصموا وادعى كل واحد أن الحق معه، ومنه نزق الحقاق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحق الثابت بلا نزاع، ولا إحقاق الحق بإظهاره.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حاق فلان فلانا إذا ادعى كل واحد منهما (maqayis)؛ حاقه أي خاصمه، والتحاق التخاصم والاحتقاق الاختصام (sihah)؛ تحاق القوم واحتقوا إذا تخاصموا (tahdhib)؛ حاققته فحققته أي خاصمته في الحق فغلبته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız başkasına kanıt göstermeyi değil, bir konudan kesin olarak emin olmayı, bir söz veya sanıyı doğrulamayı, doğru olduğunu bildirmeyi ve doğru diye belirlemeyi de içerir. Dal korunabilir, ancak gösterme işlemi bu daha geniş doğrulama alanının yalnız bir yönüdür.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğruluğu belirleme, onaylama veya gösterme işlemlerini kapsar; bir şeyin kendiliğinden doğru olma durumu ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Türemiş biçimlerin doğrulama ve kesinleştirme yönleri birlikte korunur; söz ve sanı nesneleriyle kurulan özel kalıp bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir konunun doğru olduğunu araştırıp kesin olarak belirlemek, doğru diye onaylamak veya kanıtlarla görünür kılmaktır. İşlem kişinin kendi kesinliğe ulaşmasından bir savı başkasına kabul ettirmesine kadar uzanabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin doğru olduğunu belirleyip onu doğru diye onaylama işlemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Araştırma sonunda kişinin kendisinin kesinliğe ulaşması işlemin bilgi yönüdür.
Doğruluğu kanıtlarla açığa çıkarıp bir savı geçerli kılma işlemin gösterme yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, kesin olarak öğrenme, bir söz veya sanıyı doğrulama, doğru olduğunu bildirme ve kanıtlayarak geçerli kılma işlemlerini ortak bir doğrulama alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konunun doğru olduğundan emin olma, onu onaylama ve gerektiğinde kanıtla görünür kılma sürecini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirleme, kesinleşme, onaylama ve kanıtla gösterme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün, sanının veya bilginin doğru olduğunu inceleyip onaylama bağlamlarında en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğu belirleyip onaylama işleminin temel yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişisel kesinliğe ulaşma ile kanıtları görünür kılma yönlerini açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir savın kanıtlarla ortaya konup geçerli kılındığı tartışma veya yargı bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğu başkasına görünür kılma ve geçerli saydırma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalnız kişinin kendi kesinliğe ulaşması yönünü kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sözünün veya sanısının doğru çıktığını gösterdi
savını geçerli kılıp karşısındakine üstün geldi
doğruyu söyledi veya doğru istemi kabul edildi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin kesinliğe ulaşmasını ve bir söz ya da sanıyı doğrulamasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kanıtın kendisini, yargıyla sabitlemeyi ve görme ya da düşünmeyle yerleşen bilgiyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir savın doğru ve geçerli sayılmasını sağlayan işlemleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluğu belirleme ve onaylama sürecine, komşu dal ise kanıt veya yargı yoluyla sabitlemeye daha belirgin biçimde yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğruluğu araştıran, onaylayan veya gösteren etkin bir işlemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin zaten gerçekliğe uygun ve doğru olma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğruluğun belirlenmesi veya gösterilmesini, komşu dal ise işlemin sonucundan bağımsız olarak doğru olma niteliğini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu kartları değerlendirildi; kanıtla sabitleme ile yakınlık ve doğrulama işlemiyle doğru olma durumu arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أحققت وحققت بمعنى أثبت الحق أو حكمت بكونه حقا أو صدقت القول، وإحقاق الحق بإظهار الأدلة أو إكمال الأمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد كون الشيء حقا دون فعل إثبات، ولا المخاصمة إلا إذا غلب وأثبت الحق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حققت الأمر وأحققته أي كنت على يقين منه (maqayis)؛ حققت قوله وظنه تحقيقا أي صدقت (sihah)؛ حقق الرجل إذا قال هذا الشيء هو الحق (tahdhib)؛ أحققت كذا أي أثبته حقا أو حكمت بكونه حقا، ليحق الحق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu sözü Son Gün için özel bir ad olarak verir ve adlandırmayı bütün işlerin gerçekleşmesi, herkesin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ya da karşılığın kesinleşmesiyle açıklar. Dal çerçevesi bu özel göndermeyi doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel bitiş veya zorunluluk değil, yapılanların karşılığının kesinleştiği Son Gün için kullanılan özel bir addır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal tek başına kullanılan özel bir olay adını tanımlar; başka söz öbeklerindeki bitiş, doğruluk veya zorunluluk anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bütün işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaştığı, her insanın yaptıklarıyla yüzleştiği ve karşılığın kesinleştiği Son Gün için kullanılan addır.

facets.statement: Ad, insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleştiği Son Gün olayını gösterir.
Adlandırma, o günde işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaşması ve karşılığın kesinleşmesiyle açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık adı Son Günle özdeşleştirir; gerekçe olarak işlerin gerçekleşmesi, kişinin yaptığıyla yüzleşmesi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesi biçiminde birbirini tamamlayan açıklamalar sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bütün insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşeceği ve karşılıkların kesin biçimde verileceği son yargı gününü adlandırır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel gün göndergesini, yüzleşmeyi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini veya öğretici bir metinde herkesin yaptıkları için yargılanacağı son günü belirtirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel gün göndergesini ve insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Adın işlerin gerçekleşmesi ve karşılığın kesinleşmesi gerekçesini açıkça vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bütün karşılıkların kesinleştiği Son Yargı Günü

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli bir son yargı olayının özel adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak doğru, gerçek ve gerçekliğe uygun olma niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Adın açıklanmasında işlerin gerçek sonucuna ulaşması ve kesinleşmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek bir gelecekteki olayı gösterir; komşu dal ise olay türünden bağımsız genel bir doğruluk ve gerçeklik niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insanların yaptıklarıyla yüzleşeceği özel Son Günü gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir işin tamamlanmasını, sona ermesini veya tükenmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: Son Gün ile genel sona erme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir sürecin artık sonuçlandığı bir son aşama tasarımında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bir bitiş sürecidir; odak dal ise bitiş anlamından ibaret olmayan, yargı ve karşılık içeren özel bir gündür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular gözden geçirildi; özel olay adıyla genel doğruluk arasındaki iç ayrım ve sıradan sona ermeyle tematik yakınlık yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحاقة اسما للقيامة أو الساعة لأنها تحق الأمور أو تحق كل إنسان بعمله أو يحق فيها الجزاء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل قيام للحق أو كل وجوب؛ هو اسم مخصوص للقيامة في الشواهد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحاقة القيامة لأنها تحق بكل شيء (maqayis)؛ الحاقة القيامة سميت بذلك لأن فيها حواق الأمور (sihah)؛ سميت حاقة لأنها تحق كل إنسان بعمله (tahdhib)؛ الحاقة إشارة إلى القيامة لأنه يحق فيه الجزاء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki söz burada soyut gerçeklik anlamına gelmez; kişinin koruması gereken şeyleri, ayrıca bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi somutlaşmış kullanımları gösterir. Bu nedenle dalın tanımı gerçeklikten korunması gereken sorumluluk alanına çevrilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kişinin korumakla yükümlü olduğu şeydir; doğru olma veya sözün gerçek anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Koruma yükümlülüğü yalın ad ve koruyucu kişi kalıbında görülür; bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi kullanımlar ayrı alt görünümler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin koruması, savunması ve çiğnetmemesi gereken şeylerin bütünüdür. Bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer veya korunacak çevre bu sorumluluk alanını somutlaştırabilir.

facets.statement: Kişiye düşen görev, kendisine bağlı olan şeyi korumak ve savunmaktır.
Bayrak, dokunulmaz değer ve korunacak çevre, bu koruma yükümlülüğünün adla gösterilen somut karşılıklarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, kişinin koruması gereken şeyi temel alır; bayrak, dokunulmaz sayılan değer ve çevreyi bu koruma sorumluluğunun farklı somut karşılıkları olarak sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin kendisine bağlı olduğu için korumak, savunmak ve çiğnetmemekle yükümlü bulunduğu şeyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Korunacak nesneyi, kişiye düşen görevi ve savunma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin onur, yakın çevre veya dokunulmaz saydığı bir şeyi savunması gereken bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye bağlı koruma ve savunma yükümlülüğünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bayrak ve çevre gibi bütün somut karşılıkları tek tek kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün doğrudan bir topluluğun korunup savunulan bayrağını gösterdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma sorumluluğunun bayrakla somutlaşan yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Dokunulmaz değer ve çevre gibi öteki somutlaşmaları kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: korunacak bayrak, dokunulmaz değer veya çevre

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal korunacak şeyi ve kişinin onu etkin biçimde savunma yükümlülüğünü birlikte gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dokunulmazlık, güvence, saygınlık ve çiğnenmemesi gereken bağları daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da çiğnenmemesi ve gözetilmesi gereken değer veya bağı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal koruyucu kişiyle korunacak şey arasındaki görev ilişkisini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise şeyin dokunulmaz niteliğine daha geniş yer verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal korunması gereken şeyin kendisini ve ona bağlı görevi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiye yardım etme, onu yüceltme, sayma ve savunma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da birini veya bir şeyi koruma ve savunma davranışı yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada çekirdek koruma yükümlülüğünün konusu olan şeydir; komşu dalda çekirdek kişiye yönelen destek ve savunma eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dokunulmazlıkla yakın sınır ve korunacak şeyle kişiyi savunma eylemi arasındaki ayrım yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حقيقة الرجل وما يحق عليه أن يحميه أو يلزمه الدفاع عنه، ومعه الراية والحرمة والفناء حيث نصت المصادر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحقيقة ضد المجاز إلا إذا كان السياق على الثبات أو الوجود لا الحماية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حامي الحقيقة إذا حمى ما يحق عليه أن يحميه ويقال الحقيقة الراية (maqayis)؛ الحقيقة ما يحق على الرجل أن يحميه (sihah)؛ الحقيقة الراية والحرمة والفناء وما يلزمه الدفاع عنه (tahdhib)؛ فلان يحمي حقيقته أي ما يحق عليه أن يحمى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız dişi deveyi değil, üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına giren ve yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelen erkek ile dişi deveyi birlikte kapsar; ayrıca dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildirir. Dal çerçevesindeki semirme bilgisi bu branch claim tarafından desteklenmez ve ayrı dalda yer alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ana konusu belirli yaşa ulaşıp yük ve binme için elverişli olan devedir; çiftleşme zamanı kalıba bağlıdır, semirme ise dışarıda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yaş ve kullanıma elverişlilik erkek ve dişi adlarında korunur; dişinin çiftleşme zamanını bildiren söz öbeği ayrı bir kalıp olarak genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girmiş ve yük taşımaya ya da binilmeye elverişli hale gelmiş erkek veya dişi devedir. Ayrı bir kalıp, dişi devenin çiftleşme için belirlenmiş zamanını anlatır.

facets.statement: Deve üç yaşını tamamlayıp dördüncü yaşına girerek yük ve binme için elverişli hale gelir.
Yaş ve elverişlilik adı hem erkek hem dişi deve için cinsiyete göre ayrı biçimde kullanılır.
Dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirildiği belirli zaman, kalıba bağlı ayrı bir zaman kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, üç yaşını bitirip dördüncü yaşa giren devenin yük taşımaya elverişli sayılmasını temel alır; erkek ve dişi adlarını ve dişinin çiftleşme zamanını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: dördüncü yaşındaki yük taşımaya elverişli deve
concept_gloss.applicability: Üç yaşını tamamlamış erkek veya dişi devenin yaşını ve yük ya da binme için eriştiği elverişlilik aşamasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaş sınırını, iki cinsiyeti ve yük ya da binme elverişliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin dördüncü yaşa girdiğini ve yük taşımaya elverişli sayıldığını belirten sürü bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaş eşiğini, dişi cinsiyetini ve kullanıma elverişliliği korur.
error_profile.loses: Erkek deve kullanımını ve çiftleşme zamanı kalıbını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi devenin erkek deveyle çiftleştirildiği belirli zamanı bildiren kalıpta uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı çiftleşme zamanı yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Devenin yaşını ve yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelmesini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üç yaşını tamamlamış, yük veya binme için elverişli dişi deve
üç yaşını tamamlamış, yük veya binme için elverişli erkek deve

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal üç yaşını bitiren devenin yük ve binme için elverişli hale gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal devede sekizinci yıl, koyunda altıncı yıl çevresindeki ayrı bir diş ve yaş evresini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hayvanların yaşını belirli gelişim ve kullanım eşikleriyle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yaş sayıları, hayvan türleri ve dönüm noktaları farklıdır; bu nedenle aynı alanın birbirinin yerine geçmeyen iki teknik yaş adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal devenin yaşı nedeniyle yük taşımaya elverişli hale gelmesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yük taşıyabilecek olsa bile saygı veya damızlık amacıyla yük vurulmayan deveyi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yük taşımaya elverişlilik ile yükten bağışıklık
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deveye yük vurulup vurulmaması çevresinde anlam kazanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel ve yaşa bağlı elverişliliği, komşu dal ise elverişliliğe karşın toplumsal veya üretim amaçlı muaf tutulmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kesin yaş eşiği ile yük ve binme elverişliliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal devenin veya sürünün semirmesini ve semizliğin en yüksek düzeye ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da deve veya sürünün bedensel durumunda ulaşılan bir aşamayı gösterir.
